answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the plume log shows the live set and the onyx audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 244 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 188 aliases alive hence means 188 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the haven quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 3 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
